blocks.title: Your personality
blocks.description: There are no right answers. Please answer honestly, describing yourself as you generally are.
blocks.source: 6 of the 10 TIPI items (Gosling, Rentfrow & Swann, 2003). The TIPI's own items and 7-point scale are used verbatim and the reverse-keyed pairing is kept intact for every trait that's included, but this is a trimmed subset chosen to shorten the questionnaire, not the published 10-item instrument. Conscientiousness and Openness were dropped as the traits least tied to conversational tone; Extraversion, Agreeableness and Emotional Stability keep both their items (regular + reverse-keyed) so trait averaging still works as designed.
blocks.status: trimmed subset of a published instrument, needs owner sign-off on which traits were dropped

blocks.title: A few quick scenarios
blocks.description: Pick the response closest to what you'd actually do. There's no right answer. These just help tune the cards you get.
blocks.source: Original situational-judgment items written for this app, inspired by Baumrind's three parenting styles, self-determination theory, Gottman-style emotion coaching, and parenting self-efficacy constructs (e.g. SEPA). Not copied from the PSDQ, P-PASS, ERPS, or any published scale. Chosen over a longer Likert battery specifically to keep the questionnaire short.

options.label: Calmly state the agreed limit and follow through on what you said would happen.

items.text_adult: Your adult child seems upset about something and doesn't want to talk yet. You...

options.label: Name that they seem upset and let them know you're around whenever they're ready.
Tell them to cheer up, or try to distract them with something else.
Ask what's wrong right away, a few times if needed.
Give them space and don't bring it up unless they do.

options.label: Listen and ask how they're feeling about it before anything else.
Jump in with advice on how to fix it.
Tell them what you would do in their situation.
Ask questions to help them think it through themselves.

options.label: Feel it, but trust you can try again differently next time.
Replay it for a long time, criticizing how you handled it.
Feel like you need to make it up to them somehow.
